gloss: local bus; route bus; city bus

definitions.gloss: local bus; route bus; city bus
definitions.explanation: A public bus that runs on a fixed route with scheduled stops, serving everyday commuters and residents. Distinguished from chartered buses and long-distance express buses.

examples.japanese: {路線|ろせん}バスで{通勤|つうきん}している。
この{地域|ちいき}は{路線|ろせん}バスの{本数|ほんすう}が{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: This area has few local bus services.

examples.japanese: {人口|じんこう}{減少|げんしょう}で{路線|ろせん}バスの{廃止|はいし}が{全国|ぜんこく}で{相次|あいつ}いでいる。
examples.english: Local bus routes are being discontinued one after another across the country due to population decline.

notes:
An important part of daily transportation in Japan, especially in areas without train service. In recent years, {路線|ろせん}バスの{廃止|はいし} (discontinuation of bus routes) has become a major social issue in rural Japan as population decline makes routes financially unviable.

FORMS:
{路線|ろせん} (route, line) + バス (bus)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {路線|ろせん}バスに{乗|の}る: to ride a local bus
- {路線|ろせん}バスの{時刻表|じこくひょう}: local bus timetable
- {路線|ろせん}バスの{運賃|うんちん}: local bus fare
- {路線|ろせん}バスが{廃止|はいし}になる: a bus route is discontinued

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高速|こうそく}バス: express bus, highway bus — long-distance, between cities
- {貸切|かしきり}バス: chartered bus — for private group use
- コミュニティバス: community bus — small buses serving local neighborhoods, often subsidized
